children: quickly jumped 14% after a report that Gen Digital
, maker of Norton 360 antivirus software, made a takeover offer. Gen Digital dropped 7.6%.

Discussions are at an early stage, and there's no guarantee that a deal will happen, according to a Financial Times report on Thursday, which cited people familiar with the matter. The offer was made in recent weeks.
The exact terms of the offer couldn't immediately be learned. GoDaddy has a market cap of $12.2 billion, while Gen Digital is valued at $15.7 billion.
Gen Digital and GoDaddy declined to comment to the FT.

title: GoDaddy jumps on report of takeover offer from Gen Digital
